finalists.label: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as whitish edematous lacy patches with erosions and direct immunofluorescence showing fibrinogen deposition along the basement membrane.

finalists.label: Pemphigus
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as whitish edematous lacy patches with erosions and direct immunofluorescence showing fibrinogen deposition along the basement membrane, with no against evidence.

finalists.label: Good Syndrome
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as decreased IgG serum level and increased CD8+ T count with inverted CD4:CD8 ratio, with no against evidence.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a mediastinal mass and the specific oral lesions point towards a paraneoplastic syndrome, making Paraneoplastic pemphigus the most likely diagnosis.

support_spans: Lingual biopsy showed epidermal acanthosis with scattered necrotic keratinocytes, basal-layer vacuolation, and band-like lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
Direct immunofluorescence showed fibrinogen deposition along basement membrane
Increased CD8+ T count with inverted CD4:CD8 ratio
contradict_spans: Skin and nails were not involved

support_spans: mediastinal mass detected during chest radiography performed for pneumonia
Decreased IgG serum level: 465 mg/dL
Positron emission tomography revealed a 10-cm hypercapturing extrapulmonary mass
contradict_spans: Negative for hepatitis B and C
